high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post taken at 4:14 AM, as indicated by the status bar at the top of the screen. The post features a stunning aerial photograph of a mountainous landscape with a small village nestled within a valley. The village appears to be surrounded by lush greenery and is situated on a narrow strip of land that extends into a deep canyon. The text accompanying the image provides context for the photo: Caption: "Grand Coude" means 'big elbow' in French -> can you see why? 😎 Had to go back up this ridge 3 times for sunrise to get this
